resources.name: SnG roadmap 2026 brief
resources.body:
Background

Every division set its own priorities last year, so SnG could not see where effort overlapped. This roadmap agrees three SnG priorities with all six directors before the new batch starts.

Objectives

  • Interview every division director by 14 Oct
  • Agree three priorities, each with one owner
  • Publish a one-page roadmap the whole organisation can read

Deliverables

  1. Interview notes in the shared folder
  2. Decision packet for the priorities
  3. The one-page roadmap

Where things are

Interview guide: Google Docs. Last retro: September retro notes. Mapping work happens in Map Q3 initiatives against outcomes.
